# RecDiffy.NET profiles: errors and diagnostics

> A profile problem fails before a run: ProfileDocument.Parse and Reconciler.Compile throw ProfileCompileException with a ProfileError(Code, Message) per problem, and ProfileBuilder returns ProfileProblem(Code, Message, Location). A row problem doesn't stop a run: it becomes a Diagnostic on RowResult.Diagnostics, and an Invalid one quarantines the row. Up: https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/profiles/llms.txt

## Reference

- [Compile errors](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/compile-errors.md): every code from Parse, Compile and ProfileBuilder, with its cause and fix
- [Run diagnostics](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/run-diagnostics.md): every row diagnostic, its severity, the rule that raises it, and what to do
- [Write, check and compile a profile](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/write-check-and-compile-a-profile.md): the four failures that are not ProfileCompileException
- [Troubleshooting a profile](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/troubleshooting.md): symptom, then the first thing to check
- [Quarantine in the result](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/results/quarantine.md): what a quarantined row looks like
- [Troubleshooting a run](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/readme/troubleshooting.md): install, SDK, culture and floating-point problems
